lines.en: If I were you, I would talk to your manager before making any decision about leaving the company.
You should save a part of your salary every month, even if it is only a small amount.
I would not advise you to buy that car, because it looks old and the repairs could be expensive.
Why don't you ask someone with experience? They might give you ideas that you have not thought of.
You had better start preparing now, otherwise you will be stressed when the exam gets closer.
It might be a good idea to apologize to her, since she seems really upset about what happened.
Whatever you decide, make sure it is your own choice and not something other people expect from you.
My father always told me to listen more than I speak, and it has been useful in every job I have had.
Instead of worrying about the future, try to focus on what you can control today.
Taking advice is easy, but it takes courage to change the way you have been doing things for years.
